end

_lIO100.FPSBoost = function(v)
    if v then
        if _II1OIlOOO then return end
        local st = {parts = {}}
        _II1OIlOOO = st
        pcall(function() st.quality = settings().Rendering.QualityLevel end)
        pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 end)
        st.shadows = _lO1lO01O.GlobalShadows
        _lO1lO01O.GlobalShadows = false
        task.spawn(function()
            local n = 0
            for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if not _000l1OIl or _II1OIlOOO ~= st then return end
                if d:IsA(_ll0O10l(1012)) or d:IsA(_ll0O10l(1013)) or d:IsA(_ll0O10l(1014)) or d:IsA(_ll0O10l(1015)) or d:IsA(_ll0O10l(1016)) then
                    if d.Enabled then d.Enabled = false table.insert(st.parts, d) end
                end
                n = n + 1
                if n % 400 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end)
    else
        local st = _II1OIlOOO
        if not st then return end
        _II1OIlOOO = nil
        pcall(function() if st.quality then settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = st.quality end end)
        pcall(function() _lO1lO01O.GlobalShadows = st.shadows end)
        for _, d in ipairs(st.parts) do pcall(function() d.Enabled = true end) end
    end
end
